item.description: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo., (KBSI) — The Missouri Public Service Commission on Wednesday approved an agreement involving Ameren Missouri and granted certificates of convenience and necessity for the utility’s proposed Big Hollow energy project in Jefferson County. item.title: One person killed in West Frankfort house fire under investigation
item.description: WEST FRANKFORT, Ill., (KBSI) — Authorities are investigating a fatal house fire that occurred early Tuesday morning in West Frankfort. item.title: Tennessee National Guard assists in East Memphis commercial fire response
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn., (KBSI) — About 20 soldiers with the Tennessee National Guard assisted local authorities overnight during a large commercial fire in East Memphis. item.title: Carbondale police launch online crime mapping tool Citizen Connect
item.description: CARBONDALE, Ill., (KBSI) — The Carbondale Police Department has launched Citizen Connect, an online public crime-mapping tool designed to provide residents with accessible crime information.
